title: Oswald at Atsugi U-2 base
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of Oswald at Atsugi U-2 base, about 1950s at Japan (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: because he worked at Atsugi, which is where the CIA was running the U2 spy plane program, you know. So,

plain: A researcher named Dan Sheehan tells podcast host Jesse Michels that Lee Harvey Oswald, the man accused of killing President Kennedy, worked in the 1950s at Atsugi, a base in Japan. Sheehan says Atsugi was where the CIA ran its U-2 spy plane programme, and he raises it to suggest Oswald was closer to secret intelligence work than people assume.
